description: This file defines a base activity class for an Android application, providing common setup such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and includes methods for lifecycle management and logging setup.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that handles common setup tasks, including logging initialization, for Android sample applications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism for the activity, creating a LogWrapper and attaching it to the Log chain, then logs a 'Ready' message.
